datasets.name: DScutomers

select rowid,id ,name from customers
where close_dat is  null
and id in (SELECT cust_id  FROM ins_customers where close_prefix=0)

datasets.name: DSContract
datasets.sql:
select ic.id, ic.type_id, ic.ins_date, ic.begin_date, ic.end_date,
       ic.valute_id, round(ic.ammount*(CASE WHEN (select count(*) from  operkurs  where val_kod=ic.valute_id and dat=ic.ins_date ) = 1 THEN opk.ostat else 1 END ),2)as ammount, ic.close_prefix, ic.kli_id, ic.loanacc_id,
       ic.curracc_id, ic.policy_num, round(ic.inssumm*(CASE WHEN (select count(*) from  operkurs  where val_kod=ic.valute_id and dat=ic.ins_date ) = 1 THEN opk.ostat else 1 END ),2)as inssumm, ic.franshiz, ic.tariff,
       ic.state, ic.agent_id, ic.pnum, ic.ben_id, ic.beneficiary,
       ic.userinsert, ic.commitop_id, ic.commit_date, ic.cancelopid,ins_c_car.name_cargo,ins_c_car.loading_station,ins_c_car.number_parcels,
       ic.canceldate, ic.filial,trim(ins_cus.surname||' '||ins_cus.name||' '||ins_cus.fathername) as Musterinin_ASA ,cust.id as custid,av.val_name,
       ict.terminted_dat as xitam_tarixi,abs(t.ostat) as qaliq,f.name as Filial_name,
       trim(translate(ins_cus.surname||' '||ins_cus.name||' '||ins_cus.fathername, 'IiİiIı', '``````')) as name1
       from ins_contracts ic, ins_customers ins_cus,tenostat t,operkurs opk,filial f,customers cust,avalute av,ins_contract_cargo ins_c_car,ins_contract_terminated ict
where  ic.type_id=8
and ins_cus.id=ic.kli_id
and t.acc_id=ic.loanacc_id

datasets.name: ODSAccount
datasets.sql:
SELECT   
   acc.RowID, ID, kli_id, op_id, acc_no, val_acc, NAME, open_dat, close_dat,
   DECODE (close_dat, NULL, 1, 2) AS status, bal_cn1, bal_cn2, bal_cn3,
   bal_cn4, filial, sim_otcet, tipacc, LIMIT, old_acc_no, pair_acc,
   insider, ownid, t.ostat, t.pok_ostat
FROM ACCOUNT  acc, tenostat t
where  t.acc_id = acc.id
and
 ownid = :ownid
and acc.close_dat is null
ORDER BY 
   id

where a.ins_id = :insid
